name: legal
description: Legal research tools for AI. Bundles the hosted Legal MCP server (legal.maxhealth.tech) with two skills: legal-research, for grounding any legal question in the actual provision text and case law, and patient-rights-advocate, for helping a patient act on a denied treatment, a records refusal or a coverage dispute. Covers Austrian, German, EU, Schengen cross-border, US federal and US state law, including regional codes. The server advertises the jurisdictions it currently covers. Sign in on first use.

interface.shortDescription: Answer legal questions from primary law, with citations.
interface.longDescription: Grounds legal questions in the actual provision text and case law across Austrian, German, EU, Schengen cross-border, US federal and US state law, including regional codes, via the hosted Legal MCP server. Includes a patient-rights advocate skill for healthcare disputes. The server advertises the jurisdictions it currently covers. Sign in on first use.
